whyItMatters: eval() executes a string as code. Any attacker-influenced fragment becomes arbitrary code execution, and even static uses defeat static analysis and Content-Security-Policy.
actions: Replace eval() with a lookup map, an explicit branch, or a real parser for the data format.
If dynamic behavior is required, dispatch through an allowlist of named functions — never build code from values.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm DPK-SAST-001 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and no eval( call remains in the changed files.

example.caveat: Validate userInput.type against the handler map keys; unknown types must fall through to an explicit error, never to a default eval.
